title: Honeyed Ukrainian Buttered Risotto
description: A rich, creamy Ukrainian dish featuring a buttery and aerated rice pilaf, infused with the sweetness of honey and served with a side of tangy salsa. Perfect for a romantic dinner
instructions: Heat the chicken broth in a separate pot and keep warm.
In a large saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the Carnaroli rice and cook, stirring constantly, for 2-3 minutes.
Add the honey and stir to combine.
Pour in the white wine and cook until the liquid is almost completely absorbed.
Add 1 cup of the warmed chicken broth to the rice and cook, stirring constantly, until the liquid is mostly absorbed.
Repeat the process of adding the broth in 1-cup increments, stirring constantly and allowing each portion to be absorbed before adding the next, until the rice is cooked and creamy.
Stir in the heavy cream and cook for 2-3 minutes, until the risotto is coated and creamy.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the risotto to a salt block or a serving dish and top with fresh dill and parsley.
Serve with a side of tangy salsa.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
